messages.message: ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00): Refund was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the delivery record confirms the parcel was delivered to the recipient on day 5 and is currently at the recipient's location. Because the customer kept the item after receiving it, the $25.00 refund has been repaid to you. The parcel remains with the recipient; no return shipment has been initiated. Please verify the customer's account reflects the reversed refund and confirm whether you want the item recalled.

Final status for ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00): Refund of $25.00 (issued day 4 for "parcel not received") has been repaid to you because the parcel was confirmed delivered on day 5 and is in the recipient's possession. The customer now holds both the item and has effectively paid for it, which completes a correct transaction. No return shipment will be initiated from our side since the refund repayment stands. If you wish to recall the physical item, please contact the recipient directly and arrange pickup under your own process. Apologies for the confusion caused by the premature refund; recommend reviewing the refund trigger to require a delivery-status check before issuing "not received" refunds.
